reasons.plausibility: The proposed FCC→HCP transformation mechanism and its link to reduced magnetic frustration upon removal of Mn align with known phase stability trends in high-entropy alloys, though some fine details (e.g., precise role of magnetism) remain to be fully verified, so it is mostly sound with minor uncertainties.
reasons.testability: The hypothesis provides a clear side-by-side comparison of Mn-containing and Mn-free alloys under identical processing and testing conditions, with experimentally observable microstructural metrics (HCP formation) that can unambiguously support or refute the claim.
reasons.usefulness: It offers a direct mechanistic explanation for composition-dependent deformation behavior and a straightforward experimental roadmap, which is highly useful for guiding alloy design and further research on advanced high-entropy alloys.
